content: {"argument": "The change modifies the condition from checking `length > 0` to `length >= 0`, causing the keepQueryParameters block to execute even when the array is empty. Since no keys pass the testParameter check with an empty filter list, all query parameters are removed. However, the original behavior intended to preserve all query parameters when keepQueryParameters is an empty array, making this a regression. The PR title mentions refactoring edge handling, but this change alters core functionality in an unintended way.", "concedes": true}
